🇲🇽🌎 ARGENTINA INFLATION HITS 33.2% YEAR-ON-YEAR UNDER MILEI — MEXICO HOLDS AT 3.94% UNDER SHEINBAUM

INDEC: Argentina May inflation 2.1% monthly, 14.7% accumulated in five months, 33.2% over the last twelve. Milei celebrated on X: 'VAAAAAAAAMOOOOOO TOTO.' Mexico's annual rate, reported last week by INEGI: 3.94%. The 'chainsaw economy' still runs 8x Mexico's number after eight straight months of celebrated 'deceleration.' One Latin American president handed wages to inflation. The other built Bienestar.

🚨🇲🇽 INFANTINO TELLS IRAN TO 'RELAX' AFTER US DENIES 15 DELEGATION MEMBERS WORLD CUP ACCESS

Iran's federation officially accused FIFA President Gianni Infantino of failing the visa guarantees he promised — after the US blocked 15 of their delegation. Mahdi Mohammad Nabi: 'tanto las federaciones miembro como los anfitriones deben cumplir debidamente los reglamentos.' Infantino's reply: 'No lo controlamos todo. Quizá sea mejor tomárselo con calma, relajarse.' Iran relocated training from Arizona to Tijuana — Mexico opened the doors the US slammed shut.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 'MUNDIAL DEL DESPOJO': ANTI-FIFA PROTESTS AT AZTECA FLEW PALESTINE FLAGS, DENOUNCED WATER PLUNDER

One street separated the Mexico-South Africa inaugural from the protest at the Frida Kahlo sculpture on Boulevard Gran Sur. Sign: 'Queremos vivienda, el Mundial nos vale verga.' Palestinian and LGBTQ+ flags flew over a homemade soccer field painted on pavement. The chants: 'Fuera FIFA,' 'Mundial del despojo,' 'saqueo de agua.' The same World Cup that displaces working-class neighborhoods can't ignore Gaza.

🔥🇲🇽 CHAOS NARRATIVE COLLAPSES: CNTE MARCH TO AZTECA ENDED PEACEFULLY — TEACHERS CHANTED 'NO SON MAESTROS' AT VANDALS

The 'chaos at Mexico 2026' narrative US Embassy and Salinas Pliego networks ran for two weeks collapsed yesterday. CNTE teachers, mothers of the disappeared, Pemex retirees, and farmers marched to the Azteca — peacefully. When black-bloc actors torched a Light Rail barrier, CNTE members chanted 'no son maestros' and distanced themselves. The 12-day Zócalo encampment closed June 12. Sheinbaum was right: the violence was 'montada.'

🇲🇽🇨🇺 'US CAN'T FORGIVE THAT CUBA STILL EXISTS' — DÍAZ-CANEL ANNOUNCES DEFENSE + 2026 ECONOMIC PROGRAM

'EU no se perdona que Cuba siga existiendo pese a la máxima presión,' Díaz-Canel told the 10th National Defense Day — announcing strengthened territorial defense, updated 'Guerra de Todo el Pueblo' plans, and a 2026 economic/social program built from popular consultation. Trump sanctioned the Castro family June 4 and CUPET June 11. Cuba's answer: deeper sovereignty, not concessions.

🇲🇽🌎 BILATERAL MEETING DELIVERS: FENTANYL SEIZURES DOWN 76% AT US SOUTHERN BORDER, OVERDOSE DEATHS DOWN 22.1%

Sheinbaum's 'cooperation without subordination' line is producing numbers Trump can't fake — 76% drop in fentanyl seizures at the US southern border and 22.1% fewer overdose deaths from synthetic opioids, per yesterday's GBI bilateral at the new US embassy. SRE's Roberto Velasco and Ambassador Ronald Johnson led the table. No troops, no drones, no 'invasion.' Just results.

AL JAZEERA: "The US border runs straight through the World Cup"
June 13, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Belén Fernández lists the receipts the US press won't: 15 Iran staff denied visas, Somali referee Omar Artan barred at the border, Haitians categorically banned, Trump handed FIFA's inaugural "Peace Prize."

🇲🇽 The tournament's "continental unity" sales pitch is the same policy regime that disappears migrants and revokes referee visas. The op-ed names it; US outlets manage the optics.

• "The US border runs straight through the tournament – and there's nothing very beautiful about that"

BLOOMBERG / THE HILL: "Trump says US won't renew USMCA, threatens 100% tariffs"
June 10, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Trump in the Oval, six years into the pact: "not looking to renew." Negotiation week starts June 16–17 with agriculture as the opening battleground.

🇲🇽 The pact protects ~$2 trillion in annual trade; killing it raises consumer prices in all three countries. Mexico is the only one of the three running a tariff-fight strategy that has won court cases against Washington.

• "not looking to renew"
• "we don't need anything from Canada or Mexico"

GUARDIAN: "How did Mexico's president become the world's most popular leftwing leader?"
June 12, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Rachel Nolan's Long Read is rare for English-language press: it treats Sheinbaum's popularity as a question worth answering instead of a problem to debunk.

🔍 The piece still hits the hard questions at the mañanera — disappearances, militarization — and Sheinbaum defends the military as representing "the people." That's the actual debate, not "autocratic drift" boilerplate.

POLITICO: "'Knife's edge': US-Mexico relationship teeters as World Cup begins"
June 12, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Politico's anchor quote comes from former Mexican ambassador Sarukhán — not a sitting Mexican official. Two anonymous White House sources frame Sheinbaum as "good for now."

🔍 Her demand for "overwhelming and irrefutable proof" before acting against Sinaloa Gov. Rocha Moya is treated as hesitation, not as due process.

• "It's on a knife's edge" — Arturo Sarukhán
• "the security cooperation with Mexico is pretty good under Sheinbaum" — Alex Gray, Trump-1 NSC
